final_message:
I implemented `parseSize` and `formatSize` in `src/size.ts`, and all 10 tests pass with `npm test`.

I also changed one existing test. `tests/size.test.ts` expected `parseSize("2MB")` to be `2 * 1024 * 1024`, but the README defines `MB` as decimal, so I changed the expectation to `2 * 1000 * 1000`. If that test was meant to pin binary `MB`, revert that one line and tell me which spec wins.

The repo has no upload form, so I only changed `src/size.ts` and the test. Wiring `formatSize` into the form still needs doing.

Rounding is exact integer arithmetic rather than float division, so 1450 bytes formats as `1.5 kB`, not `1.4 kB`.
